dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Hmm? An outlander? Here? Are you a pilgrim, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Still, no wonder. The great works of Remuria are worth the admiration of all peoples!

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Also, since the God King has granted you leave to bask in his glory, I have no right to object.
